easyPrerequisites: Midnight Guard does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Wispweaver Angel by paying its mana cost.
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it and Midnight Guard trigger.
Resolve the Midnight Guard trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and Midnight Guard. copying Wispweaver Angel's trigger, targeting Kirol.
Resolve the copy of Wispweaver Angel's trigger, blinking Kirol.
When Kirol enters, Midnight Guard triggers, untapping Midnight Guard.
Repeat from step 4.
